# vendor/

`makefun-game.ts` here is a **placeholder** (see the TODO header inside
the file). It must be replaced before submission with the unchanged
`starter/vendor/makefun-game.ts` from the official make.fun kit for
bounty `best-flight-game-20261126-0057` (56,282 bytes per the kit
manifest). The kit's direct `/kit/<file>` routes returned 404 when this
entry was built, so the real file could not be fetched by the builder.

The game does not import this file; `game/index.html` is fully
self-contained and plays offline without it.
